name: personal
description: Personal Claude Code skills and mods.

plugins.name: personal-skills
plugins.description: Shared personal skills for Claude Desktop, Cowork, and Claude Code.

plugins.name: complexity-lens
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: complexity, density and hotspot score above the prompt for files Claude reads or edits. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: one line above the prompt with context fill, five-hour and weekly plan-limit use, and prompt-cache use with a countdown to expiry, and one prompt when a plan limit crosses 90%; /meter adds per-turn and per-subagent usage. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: nested-agents-md
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: loads nested AGENTS.md for files Claude touches through Bash, Edit or Write; the built-in agents-md mod loads them only on Read. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: explore-model
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: runs the built-in Explore subagent on a chosen model and effort (default Haiku, medium) when the Agent call names none. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: progress-watch
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: a row above the prompt and a pane showing what background Bash jobs and subagents are doing (phases, errors, time since last activity, how each ended), plus optional extra logs and git branches. Follows jobs by itself and never starts a conversation turn. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: issue-hygiene-reminder
plugins.description: Claude Code hook: before a GitHub issue write (gh issue create/edit/close/comment, gh api on issues, GitHub MCP issue writes), adds a one-paragraph reminder of the issue-hygiene rules. Never blocks.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Run an adversarial Codex review from Claude Code through one launcher: the repository stays read-only, heredocs, git and gh work, and the run is watched for timeout, stall, and an expired login. Not for Codex itself.
